This assembly has not been rendered or checked; I worked out every transform by hand from the hole and rim geometry. The frame stays unrotated and is translated by (100, 170) to fit the canvas. All other positions below are in canvas coordinates.

- **Handle frame:** its front bolt hole lands at (139.8, 416.3), the middle under-tab hole at (485, 341.1) and the rear under-tab hole at (812.9, 302.2).
- **Wheel fork:** rotated −118° so the triangle's axle hole sits below the bar, with its bolt hole on the frame's front bolt hole. The axle hole lands at about (256.8, 577.7).
- **Wheel hub and tyre:** each translated so the hub's axle bore and the tyre's inner-rim centre sit on the fork's axle hole. They need no rotation because wheels may sit at any angle.
- **Tray:** rotated 249.86° so the body sits above the frame, with the bolt strip's end holes landing within about 0.5 px of the frame's rear and middle under-tab holes.
- **Leg stand:** rotated −57.9° with the front bracket hole on the middle under-tab hole (shared with the tray strip). The lip of the rear strut lands at about (855, 270), on the underside of the rear tube. The rotation was fixed by that lip constraint alone.

The leg stand's foot ends about 80 px above the wheel's lowest point. I found no placement that satisfies the stated hole and lip constraints and also brings the foot down to the ground, so I followed the constraints.
